newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources files $550 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources files $550 million shelf.

text.p: Western Resources Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registation to sell up to $550 million in first mortgage bonds and debt securities.
When combined with a previous registration, Western Resources will have up to $750 million in bonds and securities available for sale.
The offering will be made through Dillon, Read & Co Inc, Salomon Brothers Inc, Prudential Securities Inc, Smith Barney Inc and Oppenheimer & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for repayment of short-term debt, the company said.

Western Resources, based in Topeka, Kansas, is principally in the production, purchase, transmission, distribution and sale of electricity, and the delivery and sale of natural gas and electronic security services.
